subject: Model for work-order runs
statement: for now on, use Claude Sol 6.1 for the runs, we resume with deepseek later
interpretation: Sol 6.1 = the owner-approved Codex Sol 6.1 (codex-gpt-6.1-sol, reasoning high) behind the forge ACP proxy; no Claude model of that name exists in the factory
decision: Every new LL and HAL work order launches with --acp-authors codex (author roles on Sol 6.1). Inspectors and non-author nodes stay on DeepSeek: the ACP path serves author roles only, and moving inspectors needs new wiring plus a separate owner decision. DeepSeek-only authoring resumes when the owner says so.
